source: Wikidata CC0: all ISO alpha-2 records and all English labels/aliases/article links
query: SELECT ?iso ?name ?alias ?article WHERE { ?item wdt:P297 ?iso; rdfs:label ?name FILTER(LANG(?name)="en") OPTIONAL { ?item skos:altLabel ?alias FILTER(LANG(?alias)="en") } OPTIONAL { ?article schema:about ?item; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> } }
